question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank no. 3 requires a word that aligns with the context of events happening in a sequential or uninterrupted manner.
 
• The word "**consecutive**" means "following continuously" and fits well in the context of describing the repeated occurrence of forest fires.
 
• Other options, such as "**consensus**" (agreement), "**conjunctional**" (related to conjunctions), and "**continent**" (landmass), do not fit the context of the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Consensus (सहमति): "Consensus" means general agreement, which is not relevant to the context of describing forest fires.
 
• Conjunctional (संयोजक): "Conjunctional" relates to conjunctions, which does not fit the context of the passage.
 
• Continent (महाद्वीप): "Continent" refers to a large landmass, which is unrelated to the description of repeated forest fires.
